اعتقدن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدْنَ (iʕtaqadna) /iʕ.ta.qad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدْنَ (uʕtuqidna) /uʕ.tu.qid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اِعْتَقِدْنَ (iʕtaqidna) /iʕ.ta.qid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
